# 1000.00 USD bought for 1350.00 CAD, the USD split's figures written with a point.
#
# The regression test writes `value: "1350.00"` as `"1,350"` and
# `share_price: "1.35"` as `"1,35"`.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, Assets:Bank:USD +1000.00 USD
# valued 1350.00 CAD at 1.35, against Assets:Bank -1350.00 CAD.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_split_figure_written_with_a_comma_is_refused.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 1000 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "1350.00"
	Assets:Bank -1350.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-1350.00"
